# BunusRadar

> BunusRadar is an independent technology and AI publication producing standardized software benchmarks, reproducible datasets, and technical guides across artificial intelligence, large language models, software engineering, and developer tooling.

BunusRadar provides comparative evaluations of AI developer tools, frontier LLMs, and enterprise software architectures, synthesizing developer documentation, vendor specifications, and standardized empirical test suites.

## Core Navigation

- Homepage: https://bunusradar.site
- About: https://bunusradar.site/about
- Research Hub: https://bunusradar.site/research
- Testing Methodology: https://bunusradar.site/methodology
- Editorial Standards: https://bunusradar.site/editorial-standards
- Editorial Team: https://bunusradar.site/authors

## Editorial Team

BunusRadar content is produced by specialized domain editors and technical analysts:

- Alex Vance (Lead AI & Systems Researcher): https://bunusradar.site/author/alex-vance - Large language model architectures, coding assistant benchmarks, inference latency, and distributed systems.
- Sarah Chen (Software Engineering & Cloud Systems Analyst): https://bunusradar.site/author/sarah-chen - Cloud infrastructure, Next.js performance, API engineering, and TypeScript development.
- Elena Rostova (Cognitive Systems & Workflow Lead): https://bunusradar.site/author/elena-rostova - Human-AI workflows, prompt engineering, generative image fidelity, and developer productivity systems.
- Marcus Sterling (Enterprise AI & FinTech Economics Analyst): https://bunusradar.site/author/marcus-sterling - SaaS unit economics, enterprise AI ROI modeling, and cloud token cost accounting.

## Interactive Developer Tools

BunusRadar develops and hosts client-side developer tools:

- Free AI Chat & Code Canvas: https://bunusradar.site/tools/free-ai-chat - Multi-model conversational playground and live code artifact canvas.
- AI Token & Model Cost Calculator: https://bunusradar.site/tools/ai-token-calculator - Real-time cost comparison across 8 frontier models with batch and prompt caching discounts.
- AI Prompt Optimizer: https://bunusradar.site/tools/ai-prompt-optimizer - System prompt generator utilizing CRISPE and chain-of-thought frameworks.
- Enterprise AI ROI Calculator: https://bunusradar.site/tools/ai-roi-calculator - Financial modeling tool for engineering velocity and subscription payback periods.

## Comparative Research & Open Datasets

BunusRadar publishes open benchmark matrices and downloadable raw datasets:

- AI Coding Assistant Benchmark 2026: https://bunusradar.site/research#ai-coding-benchmark - Evaluation of Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist, ChatGPT, and Tabnine across 50 standardized tasks.
  - Raw JSON Dataset: https://bunusradar.site/datasets/ai-coding-assistants-benchmark-2026.json
  - Raw CSV Dataset: https://bunusradar.site/datasets/ai-coding-assistants-benchmark-2026.csv
- LLM Pricing & Token Cost Tracker: https://bunusradar.site/research#llm-pricing - Tracking input and output pricing across DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, OpenAI o3-mini, GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.0 Flash, and Gemini 2.0 Pro.
  - Raw JSON Dataset: https://bunusradar.site/datasets/llm-pricing-token-tracker-2026.json
  - Raw CSV Dataset: https://bunusradar.site/datasets/llm-pricing-token-tracker-2026.csv
- AI Image Generator Accuracy Test: https://bunusradar.site/research#image-generator-benchmark - Systematic prompt fidelity evaluation across 100 test prompts.
  - Raw JSON Dataset: https://bunusradar.site/datasets/ai-image-generators-benchmark-2026.json
  - Raw CSV Dataset: https://bunusradar.site/datasets/ai-image-generators-benchmark-2026.csv

## Evaluation Methodology

All software reviews adhere to BunusRadar's published evaluation criteria:
1. Task Accuracy (35%): Functional correctness against defined test suites
2. Speed & Latency (20%): Time-to-first-token and total completion time on reference hardware
3. Cost Per Task (20%): Measured at publicly documented API pricing tiers
4. Hallucination Rate (15%): Fact-checked against authoritative primary sources
5. User Experience (10%): Workflow integration, friction, and interface ergonomics

Full methodology documentation: https://bunusradar.site/methodology
